create.name: Sah D'Simone
create.bio:
Sah D'Simone is a spiritual teacher and author, now based in Ojai, California, whose work joins Buddhist meditation with movement and dance. He left a career in fashion after a personal crisis and turned to contemplative practice, going on to spend more than 300 days in silent retreat over a decade and to train in spiritual care at Cedars-Sinai in Los Angeles. Service has run alongside his teaching, from volunteering at a children's home in Bali to work with unhoused people in Los Angeles that earned a city award.

He created the SAH Method, a somatic dance practice that moves through breath-led postures, dynamic meditation, free movement, affirmations and trance dance. He leads it live on Zoom each Sunday with Nathan Hirschaut, trains new facilitators in a 16-week online course, and takes it to retreat centres such as Blue Spirit in Costa Rica. His books are Spiritually Sassy and Spiritually, We, and with Benjamin W. Decker he made The Modern Mythology Oracle Deck. His podcast is called Solving the Riddle of Being Human, and through Insight Timer he shares meditations, affirmations and multi-day courses.

books.title: Spiritually Sassy: 8 Radical Steps to Activate Your Innate Superpowers
books.author: Sah D'Simone
books.description: Sah's first book, an upbeat guide to building a spiritual life that fits who you actually are rather than a set image of what a seeker should be. It moves through eight steps that blend meditation, self-inquiry and service, told through his own story.

books.title: Spiritually, We: The Art of Relating and Connecting from the Heart
books.author: Sah D'Simone
books.description: Sah argues that modern spirituality has become too focused on the self and makes the case for practice rooted in community and relationship. He offers ways to deepen connection with others as part of the path.

books.title: The Modern Mythology Oracle Deck: Wisdom and Guidance from Reimagined Archetypes
books.author: Sah D'Simone, Benjamin W. Decker
books.description: A 55-card oracle deck with a guidebook, made with Benjamin W. Decker, that retells classic archetypes as figures for the present day. Each card is meant as a prompt for reflection on your own story.

courses.title: Somatic Dance Sundays
courses.description: A weekly live class on Zoom with Sah and Nathan Hirschaut built on the SAH Method, mixing breath and movement postures, dynamic meditation, affirmations and free dance. The unlimited plan adds replays and an on-demand library; drop-in places are also offered.

courses.title: The Initiation: A 7-Day Somatic Dance Retreat
courses.description: A week at Blue Spirit in Nosara, Costa Rica, led by Sah and Nathan Hirschaut, using dance as a ritual way to meet yourself. Rates depend on room type and are set by the retreat centre.

courses.title: SAH Method Teacher Training
courses.description: A 16-week online training for people who want to lead SAH Method somatic dance sessions, beginning with their own practice before learning to teach it. The next cohort is planned for summer 2027, with a waitlist open now.

courses.title: The Path Of The Wild Saint: The Making Of A Modern-Day Mahasiddha
courses.description: A 15-day Insight Timer course in which Sah tells the stories of ten unconventional modern figures and pairs each with a meditation, breathing or writing practice. The idea is to draw out the same free, awake qualities in yourself.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Shift From A Scarcity To An Abundance Mindset
courses.description: A 30-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions on self-image, comparison, gratitude, generosity and equanimity, with meditations and journalling prompts.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Sah D'Simone on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free meditations, affirmations, mantra and short somatic movement practices from Sah, plus talks on hope, connection and joy. Listen free in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: There's Nothing Wrong With You: Free 20-Minute Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation from Sah on self-acceptance, sent by email when you sign up. It invites you to drop the idea that you need fixing.

flags: Tier borderline: ~1.19M total sits in the 0.8M–1.5M band and depends on the TikTok count (read from the public profile page's embedded data, not a visible header). Without TikTok the total is ~625k (luminary).
Email operations@sahdsimone.com is an office inbox, published on the home page in a podcast-review note; there is also a contact form.

His framing leans on trauma and healing (SAH = Somatic Activated Healing; site says he helps people 'heal from trauma'; membership page mentions nervous-system regulation and health). Judged not mainly condition-led (Buddhist meditation, somatic dance, books, oracle deck), but a human should look. Bio and items avoid the trauma framing.
Availability set worldwide: Insight Timer gives Ojai, CA, but no regular in-person classes there are published (weekly class is on Zoom; retreats are in Costa Rica).
The Initiation retreat is run on Blue Spirit's site with Nathan Hirschaut; room rates load only in the booking widget.
Insight Timer bio: WebFetch quoted only two sentences; the bio check relies mainly on his own site pages.
Oracle deck co-authored with Benjamin W. Decker: possible link if he is listed.
left_out: Videos on anxiety or trauma ('SAH METHOD for Clearing Anxiety...', 'Releasing Generational Trauma...', 'Graduating from Family Trauma' TEDx, 'Somatic Practices to Stop Spiraling'): condition-named or borderline.
Short clips under 2 minutes and promos on his channel.
Insight Timer course 'Transform Your Inner Critic Into A Healing Ally' (only two IT courses allowed) and sleep-titled IT tracks.
Private mentorship: application via a Google Form only, no own page.
Emotional baggage quiz (framed on trauma and the ACE study).
